panels.description: Average size per stored object (used bytes / object count, usage metrics).

targets.expr: sum(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) / (sum(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_objects and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) > 0)

panels.title: PUT / GET Bytes

panels.description: Cumulative PUT and GET object operation counts across all buckets and RGW daemons (per-bucket performance counters).
panels.title: PUT / GET Ops

panels.description: Used Bytes : Utilized Bytes (size after compression and encryption), shown as N:1. Values above 1:1 mean data is compressed.

targets.expr: sum(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) / (sum(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes_utilized and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) > 0)

panels.title: Compression Ratio

panels.description: Top 5 users by total bytes stored in all buckets they own. Source: usage metrics (ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes), filtered by the zones of the selected RGW servers. Click a user to open S3 Analytics – Users & Buckets filtered to that user.

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (owner, ceph_daemon) (ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes * on (zone) group_left (ceph_daemon) topk by (zone) (1, label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))))

panels.title: Top Users by Usage

panels.description: Top 5 users by number of objects stored in all buckets they own. Source: usage metrics (ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_objects), filtered by the zones of the selected RGW servers. Click a user to open S3 Analytics – Users & Buckets filtered to that user.

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (owner, ceph_daemon) (ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_objects * on (zone) group_left (ceph_daemon) topk by (zone) (1, label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))))

panels.title: Top Users by Object Count

panels.description: PUT bytes per user across the selected RGW daemons. Click a user name to open S3 Analytics – Users & Buckets filtered to that user.

targets.expr:
sum by (user, ceph_daemon) (ceph_rgw_op_per_user_put_obj_bytes *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

panels.title: Bandwidth per User

panels.description: PUT operation latency per user across the selected RGW daemons. Click a user name to open S3 Analytics – Users & Buckets filtered to that user.

targets.expr:
sum by (user, ceph_daemon) (ceph_rgw_op_per_user_put_obj_lat_sum *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

panels.title: Latency(ms) Per User
